newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Romania has equal chances to secure early NATO admission as the rest of East European candidates, the alliance's Secretary General Javier Solana told the Council of Europe's winter parliamentary session.
Romania has made significant progress in its domestic politics as well as its relations with neighbours, Solana said.

* Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea, World Bank representative in Romania Francois Ettori and Karen Fogg, the head of European Union mission hold a joint news conference to present an evaluation of Romania's economic status, starting 2030 local.

* Visiting U.S. Congressman Tom Lantos expressed satisfaction at the signing of the Hungarian-Romanian treaty, saying it contributed to the region's stability and was vital for both countries' bid to get early NATO membership. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
